headline: Mota-Engil wins contract to build Querétaro-San Miguel de Allende railway section
summary: Portugal's largest construction company Mota-Engil won a contract worth €1.1 billion ($1.21 billion) to build part of a railway line in Mexico. The section runs between Querétaro and San Miguel de Allende.
why: Mota-Engil is a major Portuguese construction and infrastructure group with projects across Africa and Latin America, so large contracts shape its order backlog.
original_headline: Mota-Engil gana contrato para construir tramo ferroviario Querétaro-San Miguel de Allende
